definitions.explanation: The state of being isolated or excluded from a group, or the act of pushing someone away. Used in both everyday and academic contexts, including sociological and philosophical discussions.

examples.japanese: {疎外|そがい}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a sense of alienation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転校生|てんこうせい}→転校生：19652_tenkousei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{疎外|そがい}⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The transfer student was excluded from the class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}→技術革新：12892_gijutsukakushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧{疎外|そがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{指摘|してき}→指摘：05630_shiteki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It has been pointed out that rapid technological innovation leads to the social alienation of elderly people.

notes:
USAGE:
Can be used as a noun ({疎外|そがい}) or as a suru-verb ({疎外|そがい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to alienate/exclude). The passive form {疎外|そがい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be alienated) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疎外|そがい}⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense of alienation)
- ⟦{社会的|しゃかいてき}→社会的：04791_shakaiteki⟧{疎外|そがい} (social alienation)
- {疎外|そがい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be alienated, excluded)
- ⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{疎外|そがい}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be excluded from the group)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧: isolation (being alone, may be voluntary)
- ⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧: exclusion, removal (more active, deliberate act of removing)
- ⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧: discrimination (unfair treatment based on a characteristic)
